title: Single discards.log JSON record
description: Schema for one record (one JSON-lines row) in results/discards.log. Producer is measure.sh; consumer is analyze.py. See docs/spec/03-data-model.md §'Discards log' for invariants D-INV-1..3. The on-disk format is one JSON object per line; this schema validates a single object, not the whole file.

ts.description: RFC-3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at the moment of discard.

prover.description: Which prover the discarded run targeted.

reason.description: Discard category. Free-form text goes in `detail` (D-INV-2). 'cold_cache' is mandatory for the first run of every series (D-INV-3).

measurement_artifact.description: Path (repo-relative) to the timing.json that was generated and then discarded.
